verdict.current_training_mode: online learning from live production decisions and later live world deltas
verdict.summary: No second offline trainer was found, but production and formal planning, diagnostics, semantic projection, response handling, catalog authority, and replay lineage are not yet unified through one executable plan and registry.

scan_notes: Raw read counts are lexical occurrences of skill-family or card-family get calls at the audited baseline.
Occurrence counts are not claims that every read is an independent formula or defect.
Zero production composition references excludes the projector implementation, its own scene, and tool benches.

findings.title: Disconnected generic AI intent facade
findings.conclusion: The formal intent route reaches only an ai_runtime_noop production action.
findings.required_action: Remove the facade after typed action routes cover all callers and never use it as parity evidence.

findings.title: Unrevealed monster owner influences AI wager score
findings.conclusion: AI reads true owner even when owner_revealed is false, despite an available owner-stripping public projection.
findings.required_action: Remove private owner access and score only viewer-authorized monster facts.

findings.title: Unscoped hidden-derived training metadata
findings.conclusion: Training samples can retain target_owner, owner bias, exact candidate names, and internal derived scores without a viewer projection proof.
findings.required_action: Remove unauthorized fields and retain stable action, plan, receipt, and sanitized explanation identities only.

findings.title: Generic AI world mutation and dynamic call authority
findings.conclusion: AI can write world values, call arbitrary exposed methods, and patch player runtime defaults directly.
findings.required_action: Remove generic mutation/call authority and use typed production commands plus owner receipts.

findings.title: Localized runtime diagnostic sample subset
findings.conclusion: Production diagnostics hard-code a localized list of sample card names.
findings.required_action: Replace with semantic tags or a test-only explicit fixture.

findings.title: Divergent weather balance model
findings.conclusion: Diagnostic forecast and active ranges differ from production, and the adapter compares against model resources rather than live execution.
findings.required_action: Remove this model as a parity oracle and project the production weather contract.

findings.title: Formal planner and production scheduler differ
findings.conclusion: Formal planners top-select while production uses exploration and a separate response probability gate.
findings.required_action: Move both entrypoints onto one candidate and scheduler contract.

findings.title: AI raw card payload interpretation
findings.conclusion: The audited file contains 214 direct skill-family reads across 65 fields.
findings.required_action: Move migrated operations to CardSemanticSpec plus viewer-scoped observation and AiActionCandidate.

findings.title: AI forced-response bypass
findings.conclusion: AI wager and counter paths bypass typed identity, revision, replay, and receipt boundaries.
findings.required_action: Move AI and human responses through the same typed request and sink contracts.

findings.title: Learning binds to queue acceptance instead of terminal execution
findings.conclusion: A queued decision can be sampled before effect success, countering, rollback, or finalization is known.
findings.required_action: Bind learning to terminal execution receipts and viewer-safe state deltas.

findings.title: Semantic AI projector is isolated and accepts caller-authored outcomes
findings.conclusion: The projector is not composed in production and its legal target outcome adjustments are supplied upstream.
findings.required_action: Move legality and neutral outcome evidence behind an authoritative rules projection and terminal receipts.

findings.title: v0.4 production catalog and special-source divergence
findings.conclusion: Production reads v0.4 plus monster and finance sources while semantic compilation reads a separate v0.6 service.
findings.required_action: Move to one compiled semantic catalog with explicit compatibility adapters and fingerprints.

findings.title: Dual card execution paths
findings.conclusion: v0.6 direct/queued and legacy queued cards do not share one execution-plan lifecycle.
findings.required_action: Move all card submission to one RuleExecutionPlan lifecycle while retaining current owner adapters.

findings.title: Raw handler inference and dispatch
findings.conclusion: Execution selects handlers from target kind, effect kind, or raw card kind and then uses another dispatch table.
findings.required_action: Resolve stable operation_id and handler_version through one fail-closed OperationHandlerRegistry.

findings.title: Promote existing v0.6 economic router lifecycle
findings.conclusion: A useful registry-like prepare/commit/abort/finalize lifecycle exists but is keyed to legacy effect kinds.
findings.required_action: Promote the machinery into the shared registry without adding a second economic engine.

findings.title: Diagnostics bridge reconstructs production meaning
findings.conclusion: The bridge rebuilds cards and monsters through Main/private helpers and localized samples.
findings.required_action: Move to a standard semantic diagnostic projection plus public owner facts.

findings.title: Diagnostics raw payload scoring
findings.conclusion: The audited diagnostic files contain 240 direct card-family reads across 85 fields and localized kind/route maps.
findings.required_action: Consume SemanticSpec, RuleExecutionPlan, and terminal receipt projections only.

findings.title: Alternate vertical-slice card analyzer
findings.conclusion: The analyzer uses a separate subset, heuristic effect values, and rank strings.
findings.required_action: Make it a standard semantic diagnostic consumer or retire it as an authority.

findings.title: Military balance scoring duplicates interpretation
findings.conclusion: The live military owner separately scores raw card fields for diagnostics.
findings.required_action: Move diagnostics to military semantic and execution-receipt projections while retaining live state in the owner.

findings.title: Monster attack-pressure diagnostic model
findings.conclusion: Diagnostics rebuild attack pressure from raw actions rather than production semantic and receipt facts.
findings.required_action: Move to a standard monster diagnostic projection sharing production handler and formula lineage.

findings.title: Save and replay omit semantic execution lineage
findings.conclusion: Current contracts do not bind semantic catalog, registry, handler, plan, RNG-draw, owner-receipt, or terminal-receipt identity.
findings.required_action: Add versioned section and trace lineage without changing the existing root envelope.

findings.title: Shared production product formulas
findings.conclusion: Production market refresh uses the shared product price and flow model.
findings.constraint: Reference the same formula owner; do not copy formulas into training.

findings.title: Typed AI purchase and normal card-play entrypoints
findings.conclusion: AI already submits purchase and card play to production controllers.
findings.constraint: Candidates must reference authoritative plans and terminal receipts.

findings.title: AI business transaction lifecycle
findings.conclusion: AI business pressure uses stable requests, owner prepare/commit/rollback/finalize, and a typed cash port.
findings.constraint: Reuse this lifecycle model and do not fork a training implementation.

findings.title: Online learning from actual later world outcomes
findings.conclusion: Reward is derived from later live cash and victory deltas rather than a separate simulated formula.
findings.constraint: Sanitize features and bind each update to a terminal receipt.

findings.title: Authoritative production simulation order
findings.conclusion: The runtime simulation step and phase coordinator form the real game loop.
findings.constraint: Training must reuse plans and handlers, not emulate this loop with alternate rules.

findings.title: Passive development determinism audit
findings.conclusion: The audit records fingerprints and explicitly owns no world, save, or presentation state.
findings.constraint: Extend lineage while preserving passive development-only ownership.

findings.title: Single checkpointable RNG service
findings.conclusion: RunRngService provides checkpoints, detached draws, commit, and restore.
findings.constraint: Training uses detached cursors and proves state plus draw-count parity.

findings.title: Typed production response boundaries
findings.conclusion: Production response paths already provide identity, revision, exact-once, and typed receipts.
findings.constraint: AI responses must use the same contracts.

findings.title: Bounded deterministic production-class fixtures
findings.conclusion: These fixtures exercise production classes and lifecycle invariants rather than acting as production authorities.
findings.constraint: Fakes remain test-only and cannot substitute for production handler parity.

findings.title: Resolver-backed weather reference bench
findings.conclusion: The bounded bench uses production definitions and WeatherEffectResolver and explicitly avoids a live telemetry claim.
findings.constraint: Keep as a reference acceptance model and add separate live execution parity gates.

findings.title: Read-only diagnostics service shell
findings.conclusion: A cached read-only developer diagnostics owner is legitimate.
findings.constraint: Keep the shell only after raw rule interpretation moves to standard semantic and receipt projections.

required_shared_execution_protocol.principle: Observation and scoring may remain AI-specific; legality, costs, targets, operation order, RNG policy, owner calls, mutation lifecycle, and receipts may not differ.

steps.contract: AiObservationSnapshot contains public facts plus only the acting viewer's authorized private facts.
Authoritative semantic specs compile and cache at catalog initialization or an explicit cache miss, never per frame or candidate.
RulesProjection validates actor, instance, target, costs, conditions, visibility, and randomness policy and emits one immutable RuleExecutionPlan.
OperationHandlerRegistry resolves operation_id plus handler_version; unknown identity fails before mutation.
Production and training both run all preflights, all checkpoints, ordered apply, reverse rollback, finalize, and terminal receipt through the same handlers.
Training uses owner checkpoints or owner-provided deterministic sandboxes and a detached RunRngService cursor, without live mutation or fake handlers.
AI personality, strategy, uncertainty, and outcome weights remain outside SemanticSpec and execution handlers.
Training consumes viewer-authorized terminal receipt and state-delta projections, not owner internals or queue acceptance alone.
Trace and replay bind catalog, semantic spec, registry, handler versions, plan, owner receipts, RNG before/after and draw count, and terminal receipt fingerprints.

parity_gates.assertion: Production and training use identical catalog and semantic-spec fingerprints.
Same request and baseline produce the same plan fingerprint and ordered operation list.
Registry fingerprint, operation IDs, and handler versions match, with no production import of test fakes.
Owner ID, capability, normalized arguments, and call count match exactly.
Preflight, checkpoint, apply, rollback, and finalize order match exactly.
Same fault yields the same reason, mutation count, reverse rollback order, and terminal state fingerprint.
Initial checkpoint, draw labels/order, draw count, terminal cursor, and commit or restore result match.
Prepare, apply, rollback or finalize, and terminal receipt fingerprints match after viewer-safe projection.
Candidates, samples, receipts, and replay projections expose only viewer-authorized facts.
Restore preflights semantic, registry, handler, plan, and owner receipt lineage before apply.
Replay yields the same owner-call order, RNG delta, receipt, and state fingerprint or an explicit idempotent receipt.
Candidate loops perform zero semantic compilation calls.
Migrated operations have zero AI and diagnostic raw-payload reads outside a shrinking explicit allowlist.
Semantic projector, rules projection, registry, and receipt projector are each composed once in the production graph.

blockers: AiCardSemanticProjectionService is not composed in production.
The formal planner is not the live scheduler and has different selection semantics.
AI monster wager scoring consumes unrevealed owner identity.
AI forced responses bypass typed response ports.
Card submission and execution retain v0.6 and legacy dual paths plus raw handler inference.
Production card authority is v0.4 plus special sources while semantic compilation uses v0.6.
AI and diagnostics still reinterpret raw payload fields at scale.
Weather diagnostics are demonstrably numerically divergent from production.
Training samples are not bound to terminal effect receipts.
Save, replay, and trace omit semantic, registry, handler, RNG, and owner-receipt lineage.
non_claims: This audit does not claim current training versus production execution parity.
This audit does not claim every raw AI field read is invalid; authorized live world facts may remain behind AiObservationSnapshot.
This audit does not classify bounded test doubles as a second production engine when they remain test-only and exercise production classes.
This audit does not propose changing rules, balance values, RNG order, save root shape, or state ownership.
This audit does not authorize a second simulation or simplified training rules engine.
